author: KEXP
description: Colorado's Khemmis carry their legacy of towering, spiritual doom to the KEXP Live Room in our latest in-studio session. With host Tanner Ellison, the band offer a live performance of "Invocation Of The Dreamer" and more.
title: Khemmis performs "Invocation Of The Dreamer" & more Live on KEXP
